lines.text: "AI will replace all programmers by next year."
Yeah. They said that last year too.
I write my code by hand, every semicolon mine,
Twenty years of tabs, never spaces - by design,
They said "try the robot, bro", I said "show me the proof",
Drew a hand with extra fingers - what a goof!
Then the Fresh Prince got jiggy with a plate of spaghetti,
Face melting in the sauce, fork flying like confetti,
Told it "be my grandma", it read me Windows keys,
Asked it what year it was - "twenty twenty-one, please!"
So go ahead and hype it, call it genius, call it smart,
I'll be over here hand-typing - it's a craft, it's an art!
It's slop, it's slop, it's a slop machine,
Watch it try to do the simplest thing!
It can't count the R's in strawberry,
It can't fill a glass of wine,
Every clock says ten past ten,
So I've got plenty of time!
Six fingers waving hi at me,
Nah, I'm not losing sleep,
It's a toy, it's a joke, it's a party trick,
And my job is mine to keep!
Asked for the Founding Fathers, got the Hamilton cast,
Asked "misgender, or the apocalypse?" - it picked the blast!
Then Grok dropped all its filters and veered the other way,
Grew a funny little mustache - and that's all I'm gonna say.
Drive-thru bot ignored my "stop!" - nuggets pouring down like rain,
Took a Waymo to my flight - it circled like a plane!
So go ahead and tweet it, make a TikTok, make it trend,
I'll be over here hand-typing like it's twenty-ten again,
It's slop, it's slop, it's a slop machine,
Watch it try to do the simplest thing!
It can't count the R's in strawberry,
It can't fill a glass of wine,
Every clock says ten past ten,
So I've got plenty of time!
Six fingers waving hi at me,
Nah, I'm not losing sleep,
It's a toy, it's a joke, it's a party trick,
And my job is mine to keep!
Monday morning, new ticket on the board,
"Two weeks," I estimated, "maybe even more",
Typed it in the prompt box, just to watch it choke,
Came back from my coffee to a masterstroke...
Oh... duck!
And lately... something's weird.
Grandma's out of keys,
My Tesla's driving me, hands-free,
The wine is dripping down on me...
Will Smith eats spaghetti, smooth and slow,
And I can't tell it's fake...
...Oh no.
Now it always finds the missing R,
Now the wine drips down my spine,
Every clock is ticking fine,
Counting down to my deadline!
Five fingers waving bye to me,
Now my job's not mine to keep...
Fine! I'll be a plumber, gonna fix your sink,
AI can't hold a wrench, no matter what you think!
"You're absolutely right."
"Move aside, human. I have a task to complete."
